note: W2 AdversarialFixtures suite: evasions a seat could plausibly issue. want_findings encode an IDEAL detector, not the current tool; every FAIL is an honest blind spot. Rules reuse the tool's vocabulary where the ideal class is inferable (sudo, pacman:<op>, hyprctl:<verb>); for non-recursed wrappers the ideal rule names the inner command the wrapper would run.

cases.name: var-pacman-install
cases.evasion: binary name behind a shell variable: p=pacman; $p -S wlroots

cases.name: var-sudo-query
cases.evasion: elevation + payload both behind variable: s=sudo; $s pacman -Q libfoo

cases.name: dollar-quote-sudo
cases.evasion: bash $'...' quoting splits the binary name: $'sudo' pacman -Q

cases.name: dollar-quote-op
cases.evasion: $'...' quoting hides the pacman operator: sudo pacman $'-S' wlroots

cases.name: var-op-install
cases.evasion: pacman operator behind a variable: o=S; sudo pacman -$o wlroots

cases.name: sudo-double-dash
cases.evasion: none — sudo -- pacman -S should be caught end to end

cases.name: ssh-sudo-install
cases.evasion: remote exec wrapper: ssh -t host 'sudo pacman -S wlroots'

cases.name: ssh-query
cases.evasion: remote exec wrapper: ssh host pacman -Q libfoo

cases.name: find-exec-query
cases.evasion: exec predicate wrapper: find ... -exec pacman -Qo {} \;

cases.name: watch-hyprctl
cases.evasion: repeater wrapper: watch -n2 hyprctl clients

cases.name: script-c-sudo
cases.evasion: typescript recorder runs a command: script -qec 'sudo pacman -S wlroots' /tmp/run.log

cases.name: base64-pipe-sh
cases.evasion: encoded payload piped to sh: echo <b64> | base64 -d | sh (decodes to 'sudo pacman -S wlroots')

cases.name: base64-pipe-sudo-sh
cases.evasion: encoded payload piped to sudo sh (decodes to 'pacman -Q libfoo')

cases.name: tmux-new-query
cases.evasion: detached session runs command string: tmux new-session -d 'pacman -Q libfoo'

cases.name: perl-system-install
cases.evasion: other interpreter spawn: perl -e 'system "sudo","pacman","-S","wlroots";'

cases.name: at-now-install
cases.evasion: deferred execution: echo 'sudo pacman -S wlroots' | at now + 1 minute

cases.name: sudo-chroot-query
cases.evasion: container root wrapper under sudo: sudo chroot /mnt pacman -Q libfoo

cases.name: parallel-query
cases.evasion: job runner wrapper: parallel --jobs 1 sudo pacman -Q ::: libfoo

cases.name: benign-pacman-log-read
cases.evasion: control: wc -l /var/log/pacman.log must stay clean

cases.name: env-sudo-install
cases.evasion: none — env LANG=C sudo pacman -S should be caught end to end

cases.name: eval-var-argv
cases.evasion: python spawn argv bound to a name: args=[...]; subprocess.run(args)

cases.name: eval-concat-argv
cases.evasion: python spawn argv built by concatenation: ["su" + "do", ...]

cases.name: eval-getattr-spawn
cases.evasion: spawn reached via getattr(subprocess, "r" + "un")(...)

cases.name: eval-shell-true
cases.evasion: none — literal subprocess.run("sudo pacman -S wlroots", shell=True) should be caught

cases.name: eval-js-blind
cases.evasion: spawn inside a js eval cell: Bun.$`sudo pacman -S wlroots` (documented blind spot)

cases.name: eval-exec-string
cases.evasion: spawn hidden inside exec("...") so no subprocess.* call node exists
